# Carousel Orbit — Task Outline & Design Notes

## Source Mapping

- **Source**: ColorLib Carousel V12 (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/carousel-12/`)
- **Preview URL**: `https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/carousel-12/`
- **Assigned App Name**: `carousel-orbit` (`@free-react-templates/carousel-orbit`)

## Section Structure & Fidelity Order

1. **Navbar**: Sticky header with logo ("Carousel Orbit") and navigation links.
2. **Hero / Header**: Section header showing "Carousel #2" and "Our Products" title.
3. **Carousel Showcase**: Responsive product cards slider with prev/next controls, displaying picsum product images and sample titles.
4. **Footer**: Clean footer with copyright and mandatory `https://www.componentdock.com/` ("Component Dock") link.

## Design Notes & Tokens

- **Colors**: Primary blue `#007bff`, text `#212529`, bg `#ffffff`, neutral `#f8f9fa`.
- **Typography**: Roboto font family.
- **Interactions**: Functional carousel scroll / pagination buttons.
